description:
A compact macOS Spotlight inspired launcher for GNOME Shell.

This is a fork of the original Spotlight extension, rebranded as Lumen launch with new theming and a full app list.

Features:
* Instant app search with fuzzy matching - type 'ffx' to find Firefox
* Apps ranked by fuzzy match score and usage frequency
* All installed apps shown when the search box is empty (most-used first)
* List rows or a responsive icon grid (5 columns at the default width, up to 9 as the popup widens)
* Configurable result cap per category: All (default, scroll through everything) or a fixed number
* 6 color themes (Dark, Light, Nord, Dracula, One Dark, Solarized Light)
* Inline calculator (type '12 * 8 + 3', press Enter to copy result to clipboard)
* System actions (lock, suspend, restart, shut down, log out, switch user)
* GNOME Settings panels search (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Display, etc.)
* File and folder search under Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Pictures, Music, Videos, and Templates
* Web search fallback - only appears when no local results match (Google / DuckDuckGo / Brave / Bing / Startpage)
* Always opens centered on the primary monitor

DATA ACCESS: File search reads filenames and file types only, under the standard user directories listed above. It never reads file contents. The extension makes no network requests except when the user activates a web search result.

CLIPBOARD ACCESS: This extension writes to the clipboard ONLY when the user explicitly selects a calculator result (presses Enter on a math expression). No clipboard data is read or transmitted to any third party. This is a user-initiated action, not background access.

Open with Ctrl+Space (set in preferences).
name: Lumen launch
